dengue.name: Dengue
dengue.description: Dengue is a viral infection transmitted primarily by infected Aedes mosquitoes.
sources: World Health Organization
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

malaria.name: Malaria
malaria.description: Malaria is a mosquito-borne disease caused by parasites.
sources: World Health Organization
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

influenza.name: Influenza
influenza.description: Influenza is a contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses.
prevention: Avoid close contact with sick people
warning_signs: Symptoms that become severe or worsen
sources: World Health Organization
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

chikungunya.name: Chikungunya
chikungunya.description: Chikungunya is a viral disease transmitted by infected Aedes mosquitoes.
warning_signs: Symptoms that become severe or worsen
sources: World Health Organization
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

covid19.name: COVID-19
covid19.description: COVID-19 is an infectious disease caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus.
prevention: Avoid close contact when feeling unwell
warning_signs: Symptoms that become severe or worsen
sources: World Health Organization
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

typhoid.name: Typhoid
typhoid.description: Typhoid fever is a bacterial infection that can spread through contaminated food or water.
warning_signs: Symptoms that become severe or worsen
sources: World Health Organization
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

cholera.name: Cholera
cholera.description: Cholera is an acute diarrhoeal infection that can spread through contaminated food or water.
sources: World Health Organization
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

tuberculosis.name: Tuberculosis
tuberculosis.description: Tuberculosis is an infectious disease caused by bacteria that most commonly affects the lungs.
prevention: Seek medical evaluation for persistent symptoms
warning_signs: Cough lasting for a long time
sources: World Health Organization
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

hepatitis_a.name: Hepatitis A
hepatitis_a.description: Hepatitis A is a viral liver infection that can spread through contaminated food or water.
warning_signs: Symptoms that become severe or worsen
sources: World Health Organization
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

measles.name: Measles
measles.description: Measles is a highly contagious viral disease that can cause fever and a widespread rash.
prevention: Avoid close contact with infected people
warning_signs: Symptoms that become severe or worsen
sources: World Health Organization
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

common_cold.name: Common Cold
common_cold.description: The common cold is a common viral infection of the upper respiratory tract.
prevention: Avoid touching the face with unwashed hands
warning_signs: Symptoms that become severe or worsen
sources: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

heat_illness.name: Heat-related Illness
heat_illness.description: Heat-related illness can occur when the body becomes unable to cope with high temperatures.
prevention: Avoid prolonged exposure to extreme heat
Take breaks in cool or shaded areas
sources: World Health Organization
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
